entities.summary: Monique Laederach was a Swiss writer and translator. She published poems, novels, radio plays, plays for the theatre and literary criticism. Laederach also translated works by German-language writers such as Kafka, Rilke, Erika Burkart and Adolf Muschg into French. Laederach was a member of the Gruppe Olten. A complete collection of her poems was published in 2003. She received the Schiller Prize in 1977, 1982 and 2000.
